name: Mixed Phenotype Acute Leukemia with t(v;11q23.3)

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: WHO Classification of Tumors of Hematopoietic and Lymphoid Tissues (2016)

criteria.description: Presence of leukemic blasts expressing markers of more than one hematopoietic lineage (myeloid and lymphoid) confirmed by flow cytometry or immunohistochemistry
Detection of t(v;11q23.3) involving the KMT2A (MLL) gene rearrangement by cytogenetic or molecular methods
Morphological features consistent with acute leukemia including presence of blasts in bone marrow or peripheral blood
Exclusion of other defined acute leukemias such as pure acute lymphoblastic leukemia or acute myeloid leukemia without mixed phenotype

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of blasts expressing markers of multiple hematopoietic lineages plus confirmation of t(v;11q23.3) KMT2A rearrangement
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires integration of immunophenotyping, cytogenetics, and morphology per WHO criteria.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Leukemic blasts expressing both myeloid and lymphoid markers
searchTerms: leukemia cells with mixed lineage markers
cancer cells showing both myeloid and lymphoid features

pathognomonic.symptomName: Presence of t(v;11q23.3) KMT2A gene rearrangement
pathognomonic.notes: Detected by cytogenetic or molecular testing

searchTerms: pale skin and tiredness from anemia
fatigue and pallor due to low red blood cells

common.symptomName: Thrombocytopenia causing petechiae and easy bruising
searchTerms: low platelets causing small red spots
petechiae and bleeding from low platelets
frequent infections due to low white cells

occasional.symptomName: Bone pain due to marrow expansion

occasional.notes: May be due to cytokine release
searchTerms: temperature rise with no infection found
losing weight and sweating at night

rare.symptomName: Central nervous system involvement with neurological deficits
searchTerms: nerve deficits due to CNS involvement

laboratory: Peripheral blood and bone marrow blasts expressing both myeloid and lymphoid markers
Anemia, thrombocytopenia, and neutropenia on complete blood count
imaging: MRI or CT for CNS involvement if neurological symptoms present
other: Flow cytometry immunophenotyping confirming mixed lineage antigen expression

distinguishingFeatures: Different cytogenetic abnormalities without KMT2A rearrangement

redFlags: Rapidly increasing peripheral blood blast count
Signs of bone marrow failure (severe anemia, bleeding, infections)
references: WHO Classification of Tumors of Hematopoietic and Lymphoid Tissues, 2016
